pois.blurb_en: South Rim basecamp: visitor center, lodges, dining and the free shuttle hub.
pois.blurb_zh: 南缘大本营：游客中心、住宿餐饮、免费摆渡车总站都在这儿。

pois.blurb_en: The classic corridor trailhead — water and shade, great even for a short out-and-back.
pois.blurb_zh: 最经典的下谷步道起点，有水有遮阴，新手走一段即回也值得。

pois.blurb_en: The classic South Rim overlook — front row for sunrise, walkable from the visitor center.
pois.blurb_zh: 南缘最经典的观景点，看日出第一排，游客中心步行可达。

pois.blurb_en: Home of the Geology Museum — read 2 billion years of rock layers, then look.
pois.blurb_zh: 地质博物馆所在地，看懂峡谷二十亿年地层再看景。

pois.blurb_en: Pueblo-style stone tower with panoramic views of the canyon and the Colorado's bend.
pois.blurb_zh: 印第安风格石塔，登顶俯瞰峡谷与科罗拉多河大拐弯。

pois.blurb_en: One of the widest South Rim vistas; trailhead of the historic Grandview Trail.
pois.blurb_zh: 南缘视野最开阔的点之一，Grandview 步道起点，老矿道历史。

pois.blurb_en: Stone resthouse at the west end of Hermit Road — best done at sunset via the Red shuttle.
pois.blurb_zh: 西缘终点石屋，红线摆渡车一路观景点串到底，最适合日落。

pois.blurb_en: The most scenic descent (no water, no shade) — Ooh Aah Point makes a perfect turnaround.
pois.blurb_zh: 景色最壮观的下谷步道（无水无遮阴），走到 Ooh Aah 点回头刚好。

pois.blurb_en: Quiet overlook near South Kaibab, shuttle-accessible and less crowded than Mather.
pois.blurb_zh: 南凯巴布旁的安静观景点，摆渡车可达，人比马瑟点少。

pois.blurb_en: One of the best river views on the South Rim, overlooking the Unkar Delta.
pois.blurb_zh: 看科罗拉多河视角最好的观景点之一，Unkar 三角洲尽收眼底。

pois.blurb_en: Named for the painter — three rock layers in one frame, a photographer favorite.
pois.blurb_zh: 以画家命名的观景点，三层地层色彩同框，摄影爱好者常来。

pois.blurb_en: 800-year-old Pueblo ruin with a small museum — Native history on Desert View Drive.
pois.blurb_zh: 800 年前的普韦布洛遗址 + 小型博物馆，顺路了解原住民历史。

pois.blurb_en: Cliff-edge historic photo studio with century-old canyon films and rotating exhibits.
pois.blurb_zh: 悬崖边的老照相馆，Kolb 兄弟百年前的峡谷影像展，常有画展。

pois.blurb_en: Historic lodge with a cliff-edge restaurant at sunset — book rooms far ahead.
pois.blurb_zh: 百年历史小屋，悬崖边的餐厅看日落，住宿要提前很久订。
